_why: P3342 (16/11/2026 Paris): hard ceiling for the UPLOAD app.json bytes (the file prepare-publish writes, after the P3047 ASCII pass). P3340 ties Athom's processing failures (bare AggregateError) to the work per build, which grows with the manifest: stable at 2.85 MB has never been refused, master 3.39 MB was. P3342 brought master to ~3.17 MB losslessly (CI payload ~14 KB larger). Growth above this ceiling blocks prepare-publish and the Platform Budget check. Lower it as the manifest shrinks; raising it needs the owner's go and a new Athom data point (docs/knowledge/athom-driver-ceiling.md).
